scope: 512 training products; 128 per each of four categories; descriptive and exploratory comparison only
invalid_inputs_rejected: any missing/duplicate/mismatched keys, non-finite embeddings, invalid/no real provenance

algorithms.diagnostic: DBSCAN where feasible; never forced to have valid clusters

primary_metric: cosine silhouette, within representation only; caution cross-space comparison

selection_rule.first: reject incomplete and invalid or label-leaking experiments
selection_rule.second: within each space prefer solutions with no clusters under 10 and seed ARI median>=0.75, subsample ARI median>=0.60
selection_rule.third: among eligible k maximize cosine silhouette; ties absolute <=0.01 resolved by better min(seed/subsample ARI), then smaller k
selection_rule.fourth: if no k meets warnings, choose least-invalid transparently and record limitations; don't invent pass
selection_rule.fifth: choose representation on multi-criterion evidence including stability, interpretability, sample coverage, and efficiency; no mandatory winner where conflicting

selection_cutoffs_are: pre-execution decision heuristics, not formal requirements or universal statistical guarantees
data_use: train-only; no future reviews 6-15, target, test, or metadata snapshot in fit/selection; category/rating only post hoc except separately labeled numeric ablations
sample_limitation: balanced comparison sample, not representative of category proportions or full Amazon population; no CI or prevalence estimates generalized without design correction
report_rule: do not equate clustering quality with downstream predictive accuracy; do not claim optimal globally; do not fabricate real runs
